newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - More rain expected in Kansas.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - More rain expected in Kansas.

text.p: More rain was expected to fall Thursday in western and central areas of Kansas and Oklahoma, grain dealers said.

The forecasts for more rain prompted mixed feelings among grain merchandisers and farmers. Kansas dealers said the rain was probably still needed, while Oklahoma dealers said farmers were hoping for warm, dry weather instead of rain.

"In western Kansas there's a 30 percent chance of rain this morning, and another 30 percent chance tonight and tomorrow. The weekend rains gave us some relief, but more would be welcome," a south central Kansas dealer said.
"Rain's being forecast for western Oklahoma over the next three days. We really don't need any more. We need to dry out and get with the program," a north central Oklahoma dealer said.
Meanwhile, basis bids for hard red winter wheat were mixed and movement remained extremely slow.
